content:
For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“Make them look like Swiss Cheese!”

**Tenderizer** is a Charisma-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Striking a target will cause them to receive +0.1% damage per hit up to +100%.

Tenderizer is unique in that it works by allowing multiple players equipped with the card to contribute to the overall debuff by striking the same enemy. The enemy debuff is indefinite and all the players benefit from it. The debuff applied to the enemy stacks additively with other damage buffs like Number Cruncher, Psycho, and Bullet Storm.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Each attack makes your target take increased damage. | 003E21F4 | 

- Does not work in PvP.
- The debuff does not retroactively increase the damage dealt by the shot that applied it.

- Update 58 reduced ranks and changed the effect. Previous effect was "Make your target receive 5%/7%/10% more damage for 5/7/10 seconds after you attack." It could be stacked up to 40% if multiple players with this perk attack the same enemy.
- As of patch 23, the damage values were increased from 5/6/7% to 5/7/10%. (Adventure Mode only)
